dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam. What's the problem today?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm. ˈwʌts ðə ˈprɑːbləm təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My back hurts, and my arms hurt, too.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈbæk ˈhɜːrts, ənd maɪ ˈɑːrmz ˈhɜːrt, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I play volleyball on Tuesday and Thursday.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈpleɪ ˈvɑːlibɔːl ɑːn ˈtuːzdeɪ ənd ˈθɜːrzdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My legs are OK, but my knee hurts a little.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈlɛɡz ər oʊˈkeɪ, bʌt maɪ ˈniː ˈhɜːrts ə ˈlɪtəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it doesn't. Just my back, my arms and my knee.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈdʌzənt. ˈdʒʌst maɪ ˈbæk, maɪ ˈɑːrmz ənd maɪ ˈniː.
